description: This file defines the TransactionsRepository class which acts as an interface to retrieve transaction data from a local mock data source in a Dart-based expense tracker app.

classes.name: TransactionsRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to fetch all transactions or transactions for a specific month from a local mock data source.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all transactions from the data source.

methods.name: getForMonth
methods.description: Filters and returns transactions that occur within the specified month.
